context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 56 fully passes. When testing shop-layout again, note that the DB now has ZERO shop_categories and the /shop-categories/tree endpoint is cached client-side for 10 min. Login on the web preview: use `page.fill('[data-testid=login-email-input]', ...)` and `page.fill('[data-testid=login-password-input]', ...)` — `page.keyboard.type` after `.click()` is flaky on RN-Web TextInputs. rca_of_issue: No issues found. Test coverage: (1) POST /admin/shop-layout normalises scope_pincodes (drops junk 'abc' and short '51764', de-dupes, keeps order); (2) GET /shop-layout?pincode= includes matching, excludes non-matching, excludes for unknown-location customers; global blocks still returned; (3) legacy single scope_pincode block still matches and is back-filled to scope_pincodes=['517644'] on admin read; (4) same behaviour on scope=category blocks; (5) PATCH scope_pincodes=['500001'] → both fields rewritten, mirrored; PATCH scope_pincodes=[] → block becomes global (both fields empty); PATCH with 3 targets → legacy scope_pincode cleared to ''; (6) Vendor cash summary — placed a COD order, cod_pending_total rose by cod_due; PATCH-delivered via /vendor/orders/{id}/status → pending fell, cod_collected_today rose by same amount, delivered_count +1; (7) delivered_at stamped on first placed→delivered transition and NOT overwritten by a repeat status=delivered PATCH (verified with 1.1s wall-clock gap). Frontend: (a) Admin list shows 'N PINCODES' badge for multi-targets, distinct pincode chips row displays every pincode across all targets (517644, 517640, 500001, 500002, 500003 all shown); (b) Filter '5176' keeps b1(multi 517644+517640) and b3(single 517644), hides b2(500xxx); Filter '500001' isolates b2; (c) Edit modal chip builder renders correct chips, adding a 3rd chip shows hint 'Shows only to customers in 3 pincodes.', tapping a chip removes it, 'Clear all' empties list with hint 'No pincodes added — this block shows in every area.'; (d) Vendor dashboard cash-summary-card shows ₹260 collected today / ₹450 pending with correct counts and taps through to /vendor/orders; (e) Buyer /orders page renders 'order-group-<id>' header with '1 checkout · 2 sellers · ₹350 total · each seller ships and updates separately · 2/2' above the split sub-orders; (f) Category swipe navigation walks ITER56_Beta → cat-next → ITER56_Gamma, and ITER56_Beta → cat-prev x2 → ITER56_Alpha; the horizontal mouse-drag gesture triggers the same swipeStep and lands on the next sibling, while a pure vertical drag on the product grid does NOT change the URL — confirming the PanResponder |dx|>24 && |dy|<24 guard works.
